name: Safie Inc.
summary: Safie Inc., formed in 2014 with headquarters in Tokyo, Japan, develops and operates a cloud-based video surveillance platform under the Safie brand. It offers cloud-connected security cameras, including Safie One, AXIS and VIVOTEK models, and its own Safie GO and Pocket devices, along with software solutions. They are used in industries from retail and hospitality to logistics, construction, manufacturing, healthcare, finance and the public sector.
